scenarios.scenario-1: Install is structurally idempotent, atomic and reversible byte-for-byte.
scenarios.scenario-2: Malformed YAML is refused before editing; a failed component exits non-zero.
scenarios.scenario-3: LIVE status panel: install-dsh --panel registers the host route GET /api/mygrace.status and the browser card; the payload is built from `mygrace status --format json` via MYGRACE_BIN/$DSH_HOME launcher, honours ?path=/MYGRACE_PROJECT_ROOT/cwd walk-up, sets cache-control: no-store and reports {ok:false,error} instead of throwing (5 s CLI timeout).
scenarios.scenario-4: Uninstalling the panel restores the profile byte-for-byte, and a missing project/route/CLI/timeout renders the graceful "MyGRACE: not connected — reason" line rather than breaking the GUI.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text output and JSON envelopes are asserted by the tests; no runtime log markers are emitted by library modules.

notes.note-2: Live-route evidence in test/grace-panel.test.ts is against the real DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 loader (route registration + profile composition). A live `dsh web` browser session was not exercised in CI, so the README states that limit honestly.
